name: Vortex melodies
summary: Swirling storms in NASA IMERG rain: press Play and every swirl loops its own tune, faster spin plays faster and the dot circles once per tune. Click or press Enter on a swirl to hear it alone; Escape brings back all.
author: moran
description: Swirling storms in NASA real-time precipitation (IMERG), found by optical flow and tracked over the day. Each swirl loops a short tune: faster spin plays faster, bigger swirls louder; a low hum swells where rain converges.
